data.name: The Serena Villa Files
data.detailed_description:
Game Description

You got a job as a security guard in a women's only residence!

With nowhere else to go, you, Joo Jihyuk, start working as the only security guard at the Serena Villa, a women's only residence.

However, oddities arise in the apartment from your very first day on the job.

Despite the initial backlash of the residents who didn't want a male security guard,

you still work hard on your job, protecting them by carefully monitoring the CCTV placed in several spots throughout the apartment.

Eventually, the ladies warm up to you, and they start to trust their safety with you... while also trusting you with their heart on top of that?!

So now, you're busy catching the culprit while also catching feelings!

From your vibrant first love acted by Wang Han, to a tough detective baddie.

Plus a cat-like college student, an alluring bar owner, and a glasses-bearing office lady hiding more behind her frames!

These uniquely charming ladies (and more...) are waiting for you all throughout the game.

It could be the ladies, the other thing, or both--

are you ready to get your heartbeat racing?

Character Introduction

Sohan, your cheerful first love

"I will protect you, Jihyuk!"

The world is a better place whenever she's around, carrying the warmth of sunlight with her presence.

Sohan, your childhood friend, was your protector back then.

You never thought you'd get to see her again after losing contact once, but here we are now!

Beautiful new memories start blooming between the two reunited souls.

Yeonwoo, a lingerie company OL full of secrets

"Well, in that case... Do you want to see more here?"

This resident has a timid, quiet personality that awakens your protective instincts each time.

...or so you thought.

Behind her glasses, her strong gaze pierces through you to an unsettling extent.

What other secrets is she hiding?

Woohyun, a tough police detective

"Hold my waist tight. I won't take responsibility if you fall."

The cool, easygoing detective who always refuses your help, saying she doesn't need it.

Her gaze never falters, not even in the presence of dangerous criminals,

but you catch the slight twinkle in her eyes when she's with you!

Wait, Detective, are you blushing?

Hyeji, a cat-like college student

"U-ugh! Why would you worry about me?!"

Hyeji is like a grumpy kitten who hisses at you all day.

As she opens her heart to you, though, you see how she's a tsundere who cares more than she lets show.

She has also seen the stalker up close, so what's her secret?!

Gyeoul, an alluring bar owner

"What's weighing on your shoulders, Jihyuk? Wanna talk about it over a drink?"

A short conversation with her melts the day's wariness after a long day of work.

Each and every one of bar owner Gyeoul's moves is graceful yet meticulously composed.

Be careful not to let your guard down too much around her...

...because you'll get intoxicated by her ravishing charms.

Key Features

Interactive story from a first-person POV

The story unfolds from Jihyuk's point of view!

Explore the building in first-person POV,

checking the CCTV and patrolling around spots.

Your choice will build your relationship with the ladies.

A diverse mix of heroines, featuring Korean and Chinese actresses

Meet a wider and more distinctive cast of heroines brought to life

through the first collaboration between Korean and Chinese actors!

From a first love who shines like sunlight, to a charismatic detective,

a cat-like college student, and a heroine with unexpected hidden charms,

each character brings her own personality and story to the screen.

Even better acting and cinematic visuals

Our second collaboration with the production team behind Heroines Through My Lens!

Experience richer visuals, more natural performances,

and a deeper sense of immersion in this upgraded interactive drama.

Multiple endings shaped by your choices

Hidden choices and branching routes are waiting to be discovered.

Even the smallest decision can change your relationships with the heroines,

the direction of the story, and the ending you reach.

Play through the game multiple times and discover the different outcomes for yourself.

Special appearances hidden throughout the game

Eunbi from the first season of Five Hearts Under One Roof,

Team Leader Sung from Heroines Through My Lens,

and Qiao Zhien, a hot and rising Chinese FMV star!

Find familiar faces in the nooks and crannies of Serena Villa,

and enjoy a new experience with the actors you know and love!

About Us

Hello!

We are Storytaco, an interactive game development studio.

We are very excited to introduce this new project as our second collaboration with video production company WHYNOT Media.

This title is an interactive FMV created together by a Korean production team featuring Korean and Chinese actors. With the addition of Chinese actress Wang Han, the game brings an even wider range of charm and personality to the screen.

Our goal was to create a story that players can connect with and enjoy across languages and borders, and we hope this project becomes the beginning of many new encounters.

We will continue working hard to bring you even better interactive content.

Thank you for your love and support always!

data.short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?
